name: Wakapi
description: A self-hosted WakaTime backend: the editor plugins send heartbeats to it and it draws your coding time by project, language and editor, with badges and a leaderboard. One small container with its SQLite database on the data volume.

access.note: Wakapi starts with no account and sign-up open: the first visitor to https://<domain>/signup creates one, and that page stays open to everybody until you set WAKAPI_ALLOW_SIGNUP to false in the deployment's variables. Each account's API key, shown on its settings page, is what the editor plugin is configured with.

inputs.name: domain
inputs.label: Public domain
inputs.description: Wakapi writes this address into badge links and password-reset e-mails, so it cannot be left blank.

ports.name: http
ports.purpose: The dashboard and the heartbeat API the editor plugins post to

volumes.name: data
volumes.purpose: The SQLite database of users, heartbeats and summaries

update.notes: Wakapi migrates its database on start; a large heartbeat table can take a while. Keep the password salt: hashed passwords cannot be verified with another.

secrets.name: password-salt
secrets.label: Password salt
secrets.description: Salts every stored password hash; changing it locks every account out.
